aiCare.title: AI Plant Doctor
aiCare.name: Poto AI Care Assistant
aiCare.desc: Diagnose leaf diseases, identify nutrient deficiencies, and analyze growth rates instantly. Simply capture a photo using your phone or smart pot camera, and our machine learning models will provide custom soil adjustments and specific hydration actions.

smartSoil.title: IoT Integrations
smartSoil.name: Smart Soil Moisture Probe
smartSoil.desc: Sync your physical Poto Smart Probe to automatically measure soil moisture content, ambient temperature, humidity, and sunlight levels. Eliminates manual evapotranspiration guesses by feeding live real-time metrics straight to your dashboard.

alerts.title: Smart Notifications
alerts.name: Environmental Alert Hub
alerts.desc: Get push alerts or SMS warnings when sudden weather shifts occur. If a local heatwave is forecasted, Poto will calculate the temperature increase and warn you to relocate vulnerable plants or schedule early watering cycles.

badges.title: Gamification Achievements
badges.name: Eco Milestones & Badges
badges.desc: Unlock unique collectible profile badges for sustaining streaks, saving water, and checking in daily. Trade in rare completed achievements to sponsor structural tree planting initiatives and unlock custom coin shop themes.

sustainability.title: Sustainability Impact
sustainability.desc: By using smart Poto pots, you are directly contributing to reforestation and reducing resource waste.
sustainability.derivedDesc: Every active plant pot you cultivate helps absorb atmospheric carbon dioxide. Our eco-friendly bio-based pots prevent the manufacture of virgin petrochemical plastics, locking away approximately 4.2 kg of carbon per pot per month.
sustainability.partnershipDesc: For every Poto pot registered or purchased in our application, we plant a real structural bamboo sapling in partnership with global reforestation networks. Bamboo is one of the fastest-growing carbon sinks on Earth, absorbing carbon up to 5 times faster than standard hardwood forests.
